name: martin_optin_s1
busy_cpus_note: average number of busy logical CPUs during the run, inside and outside the taskset list; work outside it is other work on the machine (CPUs 12-23 are the SMT siblings of 0-11, so it competes for the same cores)

extra.gradients_note: all gradients, warmup and sampling (the runtime's count)
extra.sampling_note: the runtime's own 'sampling took' (warmup + draws, all chains)
extra.settings: MINT_METRIC=lowrank MINT_WARMUP=fast (the program asks for 1000 warmup iterations; the fast warmup runs 200 of them) + 1000 draws; 4 chains, max tree depth 10, target acceptance 0.8
extra.settings_corrected: settings text corrected after the run from the run's log ('warmup=fast, 200 iterations'); the earlier text said 1000 warmup
